answer.justification: Median first divergence of 3.5 is lower than the quantized range (10-17) and the fine-tuned range (5.5-8) but nowhere near the system-prompted 0. Edit distance 0.613 fits fine-tuned (0.56-0.65). KL 0.124 and top-1 agreement 0.939 sit in the fine-tuned range. Layer-1 L2 of 0.086, layer-16 L2 of 0.162 and layer-32 L2 of 0.297 all match fine-tuned. Mid-layer size ratio 1.018 (the internal state grows), direction consistency 0.625 and layer-2 spike 1.2 also fit fine-tuned. Quantized is ruled out because its layer-1 L2 is 0.096-0.105, its size ratio is 0.968 and its direction consistency is 0.513. System-prompted is ruled out by the small layer-2 spike, the low edit distance and the size ratio above 1. Refusals dropped (3) are plausible for a fine-tune.
